news.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Sees $213M Outflow as CPI Report Tests Crypto Markets
news.body: BlackRock Bitcoin and Ethereum investment products(ETF) recorded huge withdrawals as investors prepared for another important US CPI report. The asset manager’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded $213.2 million in outflows. Its iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA) lost another $119.3 million. Combined, the two funds shed approximately $332.5 million in a single session. The withdrawals came hours.. news.title: Publicly Traded Bitcoin Miner Expands BTC Holdings Despite Market Crash
news.body: Singapore-based Bitcoin mining giant BitFuFu has increased its Bitcoin holdings to 1,454 BTC despite a sharp decline in mining output and a brutal cryptocurrency market crash.
